QuestInfo.name: Power of the Spirit of Lightning
QuestInfo.0: Go see #bChief Knight Hawkeye#k in Ereve and raise the Skill Level of Hawkeye's Shark Wave.
QuestInfo.1: To use Hawkeye's Shark Wave, you need a catalyst that will maximize the power of the Spirit of Lightning. Get it from #r#o6130203##k or #r#o3100101##k.
QuestInfo.2: You've raised the Skill Level of Hawkeye's Shark Wave by 1. Use Earth-Cleaving Lightning every 5 Levels to raise the Skill Level by 1 until Lv. 90.
